title: cap fields use ordinary blocks within their restrictions
purpose: Observe the permitted body features of computed fields.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.2.1 / caps guide: field bodies are ordinary synchronous blocks with locals, control flow, explicit return and closures; locals may shadow owner fields; a callable result can be called with ordinary syntax.
